Stage.LogText: {=sp_kb_s0_log}You are waiting for news about the traitorous looter {HainZanaatkar_Link}. You hope he will soon pay the price for trying to deceive you.
{=sp_kb_s1_log}You received an urgent, blood-stained message from a pigeon. Your friend {Dost_Link} needs to see you immediately. Find him and ask what the emergency is.

{=sp_kb_s2_log}You spoke to {Dost.Name}. He revealed that the artisan {HainZanaatkar_Link} is a traitor who stole the Pigeon ciphers and fled. To find his main convoy, you must first intercept and defeat 3 of his decoy looter parties roaming the lands before they disperse. (Time Limit: 10 Days)

{=sp_kb_s3_log}After defeating the decoys, the traitor's elite deserter escort has appeared to eliminate you! Confront them and retrieve the ciphers before they escape across the border. (Time Limit: 5 Days)

{=sp_kb_success_log}You destroyed the convoy and executed the traitor {HainZanaatkar_Link}. The recovered ciphers were returned to {Dost.Name}. Impressed by your unwavering devotion, your old contact welcomed you into the deeper ranks of the realm's shadow service, promising to call upon you for four seasons of service.

{=sp_kb_yozlasma_log}You accepted the artisan's bribe and allowed {HainZanaatkar_Link} to vanish into the wilderness. You gained 25,000 gold and the Pigeon's Secret Dagger. Moments later, a dying black pigeon delivered the artisan's final cryptic message: {Dost.Name} is playing everyone; the Black Ledger hidden in the ciphers will burn Calradia. The hunt for the truth has begun!

{=sp_kb_fail_log}The traitor {HainZanaatkar_Link} and his deserter escort managed to slip across the border before you could intercept them. The secret ciphers are lost forever, and the Scavenger Pigeons have lost their trust in you.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_kb_dlg1}I received your bloody pigeon message. What is the emergency?
{=sp_kb_dlg2}It's a disaster, my friend! The artisan, {HainZanaatkar_Link}... The one who gave you the fake assassination order. He wasn't just playing a role. He's a real double agent!
{=sp_kb_dlg_tone_inq}A double agent? How could someone in the inner circle breach our security like that?
{=sp_kb_dlg_tone_skep}First you told me he was testing me, now you claim he is a traitor. How do I know who to trust?
{=sp_kb_dlg_tone_prag}Enough hand-wringing. What did he take, and what is the bounty on his head?

{=sp_kb_dlg_dost_leak}He held the master cipher archive, the true identities of every operative we planted across all kingdoms! Before dawn, he murdered two keepers and slipped through the gates. If he delivers those scrolls to the enemy, hundreds of our people will be rounded up and executed.
{=sp_kb_dlg_p2_risk}If our informants are exposed, will the high lords brand us as conspirators rather than protectors?
{=sp_kb_dlg_p2_motive}He spent decades serving the Pigeons. What could possibly drive an elder craftsman to such reckless treachery?

{=sp_kb_dlg_dost_army}Gold, fear, and paranoia! He claims our society has become too powerful and orchestrates false wars. But he is a hypocrite, he hired 70 battle-hardened deserters disguised as common looters to guard his escape. He is marching toward the border passes right now.
{=sp_kb_dlg_p3_tactics}Seventy deserters with baggage can move fast. How do we pin them down without fighting the entire garrison?
{=sp_kb_dlg_p3_force}Let him hire a thousand cutthroats. My blade will cut through his vanguard like straw. Where do I strike?

{=sp_kb_dlg_dost_tactics}He deployed three decoy looter bands across the foothills to confuse our tracking hounds. Intercept and destroy those three decoy parties. Once his decoys are crushed, his main convoy will lose its screen and be forced to face you in the open.
{=sp_kb_dlg_p4_acc}Consider it done, friend. I will bring back the master ciphers and end this treason. (Accept Hunt)
{=sp_kb_dlg_p4_prag}I will ride him down. But make sure the Motherland remembers who saved her throat today. (Accept Hunt)
{=sp_kb_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_kb_dlg7}So, {PlayerName}... You actually found me. I am {HainZanaatkar.Name}. You Pigeons are truly relentless.
{=sp_kb_dlg_p_inq}Why run like a common thief? Why steal the very ciphers you swore to protect?
{=sp_kb_dlg_p_harsh}Save your breath, rat. Hand over the master ciphers and get on your knees.
{=sp_kb_dlg_p_prag}You hired 70 deserters and spent a fortune to flee. What is in those ciphers that makes you run for your life?

{=sp_kb_dlg_k_layer1}You speak of theft, but you don't even know whose blood is on your hands! You think you are fighting for the Motherland and your noble friend {Dost.Name}. But you are nothing more than his blinded executioner!
{=sp_kb_dlg_p2_accuse}{Dost.Name} warned me you would spew poison. You're selling our defense archives to foreign crowns to save your own hide!
{=sp_kb_dlg_p2_curious}Whose blood? What did you discover in those master ciphers that made you turn against your own brothers?

{=sp_kb_dlg_k_ledger_reveal}Defense archives? Lies! These ciphers contain the Black Ledger, the secret record of every false-flag raid {Dost.Name} orchestrated! He hires deserters to slaughter frontier villages under rival banners, forcing kings into wars so the Pigeons can sell protection and intelligence at extortionate prices!
{=sp_kb_dlg_p3_doubt}Manufactured wars... Is that why you gave me an assassination contract against {Dost.Name} when we first met?
{=sp_kb_dlg_p3_skep}Even if {Dost.Name} is ruthless, you are surrounded by 70 cutthroats. Why should I trust a mercenary commander over a kingdom lord?

{=sp_kb_dlg_k_offer}Yes! I tried to have him killed to save Calradia from another continental bloodbath, but you refused! Now my only desire is to live. Let me cross this border, {PlayerName}. Take my 25,000 gold and my Pigeon's Secret Dagger. {Dost.Name} will never know. You can walk away wealthy and unburdened!
{=sp_kb_dlg10}The poisoned tongue of a traitor cannot deceive me. The Motherland's justice will be served! Men, attack! (Fight)
{=sp_kb_dlg_fight_prag}Your dagger and your gold will be mine once your corpse hits the dirt anyway. Draw your steel! (Fight)
{=sp_kb_dlg11}False-flag wars and puppet masters? Hand over the 25,000 gold and that dagger, and disappear across the border. (Accept Bribe & Let Escape)
{=sp_kb_dlg12}A wise decision... The Pigeons are blind fools, but you have eyes to see. Take the gold and the dagger. Farewell, {PlayerName}!
